assessment: This study presents a valuable and comprehensive analysis of the molecular identity of neuronal subtypes of the central amygdala, along with their spatial, morphological, and connectivity properties. The evidence supporting the authors' conclusions is compelling and includes the use of rigorous state-of-the-art methodologies for RNA sequencing and spatial profiling as well as a novel approach for integrating molecular identity and axonal projections. This study will interest neuroscientists studying the function of the central amygdala.
